scientific_integrity: A self-contained symbolic proof gives the exact optimum for every integer n at least five; the finite checker corroborates but does not prove the unbounded statement.
scientific_limitations: Only unordered four-symbol multisets and the channel leaving exactly three symbols; all maximizing-code structures and other parameters are not classified. Earlier equivalent short-distance simplex-packing literature may exist.
title: Exact quaternary three-survivor multiset deletion spectrum
